name: LeMoulin Front Desk for MotoPress Hotel Booking
author: lemoulinboldplugins

sections.description:
Your front desk. Right in your pocket. LeMoulin Front Desk for MotoPress Hotel Booking gives independent accommodation owners and reception staff a focused, mobile-first view of today’s arrivals, current stays, departures, room occupancy and upcoming bookings.

It works with MotoPress Hotel Booking Lite and Premium and reads booking data through MotoPress’s own entities and repositories. The app is strictly read-only: it never modifies bookings, payments, rooms or MotoPress settings.

Included in Lite

  • Today: arrivals, guests in house and departures.
  • Calendar: a 14-day occupancy view per physical accommodation.
  • Bookings: current and upcoming reservations with search, status filters and pagination.
  • Booking details: guest contact actions, accommodation, dates and payment balance.
  • Mobile-first interface that can be added to a phone’s home screen.
  • Automatic access for administrators and MotoPress Hotel Managers.
  • No plugin settings, API keys or separate booking database.

Privacy

LeMoulin Front Desk for MotoPress Hotel Booking displays data already stored by MotoPress Hotel Booking. It does not transmit booking or guest data to Le Moulin Bold Plugins and does not create its own booking database. REST responses containing booking information use private, no-store caching headers. No booking or guest data is cached for offline use.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate MotoPress Hotel Booking Lite or Premium.
  2. Upload and activate LeMoulin Front Desk for MotoPress Hotel Booking.
  3. Open Le Moulin Plugins in the WordPress admin menu and choose Front Desk.

That is all. Administrators can use Front Desk immediately. For reception staff, assign MotoPress’s existing Hotel Manager role to their WordPress user. LeMoulin Front Desk does not create a duplicate hotel role.
sections.faq:
Does it work with MotoPress Hotel Booking Lite?

Yes. LeMoulin Front Desk for MotoPress Hotel Booking supports both the Lite and Premium editions of MotoPress Hotel Booking.

Do I need to configure anything?

No. The plugin uses your existing MotoPress accommodations, bookings, currency and WordPress timezone automatically.

Can Front Desk change a booking?

No. LeMoulin Front Desk for MotoPress Hotel Booking is strictly read-only. It cannot create, edit, cancel or delete a booking and cannot record a payment.

Who can see guest information?

Only authenticated WordPress administrators and users with MotoPress’s Hotel Manager role. Every Front Desk data request checks a dedicated permission.

Is guest information stored on the phone?

No. Booking responses are marked private and no-store. The service worker intentionally has no fetch cache, so guest and booking information is not available offline.

What happens when MotoPress is missing or inactive?

Front Desk shows administrators a clear installation or update action. Other users are asked to contact a site administrator. It does not produce a broken or blank app.

0.9.9

  • Mark compatibility with WordPress 7.1.1 after successful testing.

0.9.8

  • Rename the public plugin identity to LeMoulin Front Desk for MotoPress Hotel Booking.
  • Align the package slug, main plugin file, text domain, contributor and directory artwork with the WordPress.org review request.

0.9.7

  • Show per-room bed arrangements recorded by Bold Guest Journey on arrival cards and booking details.

0.9.6

  • Add the shared Le Moulin Plugins admin menu and Front Desk overview card.

0.9.5

  • Use distinct plugin and author URLs for WordPress.org directory submission.

0.9.4

  • Prepare styles and scripts through the WordPress enqueue system.
  • Remove production debug logging and improve uninstall variable prefixing.
  • Mark compatibility with WordPress 7.1 for release-candidate testing.

0.9.3

  • Apply the official Le Moulin Bold Plugins identity, colors and typography throughout Front Desk.
  • Add official app icons, browser icons, logo treatments and a branded plugin details banner.

0.9.2

  • Mark compatibility with WordPress 7.0.4 after successful testing.
  • Improve spacing in the native plugin details window.

0.9.1

  • Add a native WordPress View details window.
  • Add Description, Installation, FAQ and Changelog tabs to the installed plugin details.

0.9.0

  • Prepare the working Today, Calendar and Bookings screens for public beta testing.
  • Add zero-configuration onboarding and an Open Front Desk plugin action.
  • Detect missing, inactive or incompatible MotoPress installations without blocking either Lite or Premium.
  • Show a safe setup screen instead of a broken app when MotoPress is unavailable.
  • Recover rewrite rules and role capabilities automatically after plugin upgrades.
  • Support WordPress installations in a subdirectory and installations using Plain permalinks.
  • Add an actionable expired-session screen and safer network error handling.
  • Apply private, no-store and noindex headers to successful and failed Front Desk API responses.
  • Keep dates correct when an app remains open across midnight.
  • Improve keyboard focus, reduced-motion support and modal behavior.
  • Remove Front Desk capabilities and plugin options cleanly on uninstall.

0.3.0

  • Add a protected, read-only list of current and upcoming bookings.
  • Search by guest name, email address or booking number.
  • Filter by confirmed and pending booking statuses.
  • Paginate results at ten bookings per page.
  • Open full read-only booking details from the list.

0.2.0

  • Add a protected, read-only 14-day occupancy calendar.
  • Navigate to previous and next periods or return directly to today.
  • Distinguish MotoPress bookings, external iCal reservations and blocked dates.
  • Open read-only booking details from an occupied calendar day.
  • Keep the calendar usable on small screens through contained horizontal scrolling.

0.1.2

  • Grant Front Desk access to the existing MotoPress Hotel Manager role.
  • Restore the dedicated capability automatically for existing administrator and Hotel Manager accounts.

0.1.1

  • Decode the MotoPress currency entity so currency symbols display correctly.

0.1.0

  • Initial technical preview with a protected Today screen.
